ref: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
text: Aha ánɩ́ mlɩtamakpa Nana Bulu ɔma fɛ́ɛ́, mlɩdwɛ mʋ. Bulu tɛkpakpa ɔnɔkwalɩpʋ ɩwɩsʋ ipi, tamɛ ɔtɛhɩɛ bɩtɩ ɩwɩ atsupʋ ɩsʋ.
translated: Nana Bulu is a great man, he is wise. Bulu is a man of peace, he does not fight, he does not want war.

ref: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
text: Aha mimlahɛ nkʋlɛ dɛ amʋ́ ɩwɩ bla bɛɛ, “Bulu má ɩnʋ.” Bayinta. Bamli mbusuo abɔpʋ. Ɔbakʋlɛ kʋraa mɛ́dalɩ amʋ́tɔ.
translated: He said to the man, "Bulu, come here." He came. He gave him a piece of cloth. The man took it.

ref: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
text: Ofunupʋ, asʋkpan ánɩ́ ɩbɛ́tɩ lowu ha fʋ aba fʋtekle.
translated: Good morning, I greet you all with joy.

ref: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
text: Fʋ woyitɔ atɔ ɩhɩɛ tsɔ. Mʋ́ fʋtɔpʋbʋla amʋ́. Fʋtɛha amʋ́ bʋtonun fʋ ɔdwɛ-ntsu bregyibrɛ.
translated: I will go to the market today. I will buy some things. I will go to the market to buy some food.

ref: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
text: Dɩnka ansɩ Nana Bulusʋ, afʋwa ɩwɩ ɔwʋnlɩn. Nya ɩklʋn, afʋkɩ Nana Bulu ɔkpa!
translated: Greetings to Nana Bulus, may his soul rest in peace.  We remember him, we honor Nana Bulus!

ref: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
text: Nana Bulu, ntɔfwɩ ɩbɩ pʋsuna ánɩ́ lalahɛ kʋkʋ ma mɩ ɩwɩ, asa ntɛba bobomli fʋ afɔdɩɛ-ɔswɩ,
translated: Nana Bulu, the chief, has given me a piece of land to farm, and I will cultivate it well, so that it will be fruitful.

ref: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
text: Ɩkanfʋ ɩbwɛ Nana Bulu klɛ, tsufɛ alanu mɩ isu.
translated: I will go to Nana Bulu's house, I will tell him my story.

ref: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
text: Nɩ ɔtɛkɩá mʋbʋ ansigyitɔ ɔyɩ anfɩtɔ, aha bʋtɛkanfʋ mʋ ánɩ́ oyin mʋ ɩwɩsʋ kɩ kʋraa a,
translated: I have seen a beautiful woman, her beauty is captivating, and I am drawn to her like a moth to a flame.

ref: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
text: Ɔbɛɛ, “Mlɩkpa aha ánɩ́ bʋtamakpa mɩ ɔma wa abatɔ ha mɩ. Aha amʋʋ bʋtɔbɔ afɔdɩɛ, ka ntam ha mɩ amʋ!”
translated: Listen, "Milkpa, you have been given a task to do for me. This task is to bring me the head of the enemy. If you succeed, you will be rewarded!"

ref: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
text: Oo Bulu, lalahɛbwɛ tamagyi fʋ ansɩ. Fʋtamafia lalahɛ abwɛpʋ.
translated: Oh Bulu, I greet you with respect. I have come to see you.

ref: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
text: Kɩ, awie bɛtɩ aba fia, kʋsʋ yɔ wulu anfɩ ɔkɔkpa.
translated: Come, let us go and see, the thing that is happening.

ref: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
text: Nana Bulu, máha pɛlɩ ɩkɩta mɩ. Tsufɛ fʋ ndekpoli. Pɛlɩ ɩkɩta aha lalahɛ, abʋkpa ɔnɔ bun yɔ afulitɔ.
translated: Nana Bulu, he is a great hunter. He is very good at hunting. He is a great hunter, his skill is known throughout the land.

ref: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
text: “Mɩ mʋ́ nayaɩ mɩ owie mɩ onuto ɩbʋ Sionsʋ.”
translated: I will go to Sion.

ref: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
text: Oo Nana Bulu, yaa asʋ. Nu mɩ asʋn, afʋnu mɩ isu.
translated: Greetings Nana Bulu, how are you? I am well, and I hope you are well too.

ref: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
text: Bosu kpoli, tamɛ ɔhɔpʋ ɔkʋkʋ má ɩnʋ. Bosu kpoli Nana Bulu ɛ, tamɛ ɔmɛkpla amʋ́.
translated: The chief is speaking, he is saying something to the people. The chief is Nana Bulu, he is addressing them.

ref: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
text: Alatɩ ɔsʋ mʋ́a asɩ befia ánɩ́ obégyi mʋ aha asʋn.
translated: If you see a person who is in trouble, help them.

ref: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
text: Ɔha yinhɛ, ntogyi sʋ fʋdɛ ɩwɩ adabi da, lalahɛá fʋdɛpʋgyi Bulu aha sʋ? Ekekegyiɛkɛ ɔyɩkɛhɛ fɛ́ɛ́,
translated: Is it true that the Nkonya people are fighting?  If so, what is the cause of the fight? I don't know.

ref: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
text: Nana Bulu, damli kɩ mɩ afʋhɔ mɩ nkpa. Fʋ ɔdwɛ ma ɔka. Mʋ́ sʋ lɛ mɩ tsu lowutɔ.
translated: Nana Bulu, I will not allow you to do this. Go and do what you want. I will not allow you to cause trouble.

ref: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
text: Oo Bulu, ha mʋ ogyi iwie fʋ ansɩtɔ brɛ fɛ́ɛ́. Ha fʋ ɔdwɛá ɩma ɔka pʋ́ ɔnɔkwalɩ ɩkpa mʋ.
translated: Oh Bulu, you are very good at weaving. You weave very well and your work is beautiful.

ref: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
text: Ɔtɛka ɩsa tin ɔyɩtɔ ɔtɩnɛgyiɔtɩnɛ. Otebiabia ɩta, kaka ɩkpantɔ anyɔ; wa ɩsa akɔtɔ fɛ́ɛ́ ogya.
translated: He is a man who is very strong. He is a man who is very brave; he is a man who is very wise.

ref: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
text: Amʋ́ mʋ́ bɛ́tɩn da, tamɛ anɩ mʋ́ abɔ́kʋsʋ lɩɩ tikpa.
translated: I am going to the farm, so I will not be home today.

ref: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
text: Mɩ nkpahɔ pʋ́ mɩ numnyam itsu Bulu wa. Mʋgyi mɩ ɩbʋta kpekple pʋ́ mɩ okpikplikpa.
translated: I am going to the farm to work. I will go and cut the grass.

ref: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
text: Besi mɩ dɩnka fʋsʋ tsu brɛá bɔkwɩɩ mɩ. Tsu mɩ yin iputɔ ɔpá fʋgyi mɩ Bulu.
translated: If I were to go to the market, I would buy some food for myself. I would also buy some cloth for my mother Bulu.

ref: I will always praise the Lord.
text: Nɛ́kanfʋ Nana Bulu brɛ fɛ́ɛ́. Mʋ kanfʋ mɛ́ɛta mɩ ɔnɔ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.
translated: Nana Bulu is a great person. I have never seen anyone like him.

ref: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
text: Ɔyɩtɔ aha fɛ́ɛ́, mlɩtswɩ ope kanfʋ Bulu.
translated: The sun is shining brightly, the wind is blowing gently.
